settings.max-history-size-description: Number of clipboard entries kept in history. Takes effect on the next refresh.
settings.show-image-previews-description: Decode and display thumbnails for image entries. Disable on low-memory systems.
settings.clear-history-on-startup-description: Clear regular history whenever Noctalia Shell starts or restarts. Pinned items are preserved.
settings.auto-paste-on-select-description: Close the panel and send Ctrl+V to the previous window after selecting an entry.
settings.density-description: Spacing of clipboard entries in the panel.

toast.item-copied-text-body: You can paste the text from the clipboard.
toast.item-copied-image-body: You can paste the image from the clipboard.
toast.item-copied-file-body: You can paste the file from the clipboard.
